# Lean independent acceptance

The lean request fixes AppSpec/workspace fingerprints and unavailable host pairs. Read normative AppSpec sources before work.json or implementer summaries. Inventory approved/excluded requirements, ACs, managed operations and gates using the shared canonical helpers. Inspect normative omissions in prose too. Record reviewed Markdown paths once; no heading-by-heading justification for contextual prose.

Inspect every required `(obligation, surface)` pair from `verification_surface_map(app)` in `vibe_protocol.py`. For each verified pair record real production and test anchors, the assertion that proves behavior, and executed check receipts. Inspect receipt tasks and logs; a zero exit code alone, an unrelated assertion, skipped tests or an unconnected preview is insufficient. Check shared fixtures against actual production graph and platform wiring.

Run missing safe checks using `lean-delivery.py <repo> check`. Use `--runner gradle` for Gradle to hold the workspace mutex. Current global receipts may be reused without running the same matrix again. Do not change source/tests to make an audit pass. The launcher persists your final JSON; never create launch evidence yourself.

Return JSON with:

```json
{
  "requestSha256": "actual request file sha256",
  "startedAt": "actual RFC3339 time",
  "completedAt": "actual RFC3339 time",
  "inventory": {"requirementIds": [], "excludedRequirementIds": [], "acceptanceScenarioIds": [], "managedOperationIds": [], "qualityGateIds": []},
  "reviewedSources": ["product.md", "domain.md", "data.md", "design.md", "quality.md", "flows/FLOW-001.md", "screens/SCREEN-001.md"],
  "obligations": [
    {"id": "AC-001", "surface": "component-test", "result": "verified",
     "production": [{"path": "shared/feature/Example.kt", "symbol": "ExampleComponent"}],
     "tests": [{"path": "shared/feature/ExampleTest.kt", "symbol": "saveSurvivesRestart"}],
     "assertion": "Describe the observed production path and actual assertions, including restart.",
     "receiptRefs": [".vibe/receipts/RECEIPT-real-id.json"]}
  ],
  "findings": [],
  "verdict": "PASS"
}
```

Use actual inventory, paths, symbols, times and receipts. Include all pairs, not only the illustration. `result` is `verified`, `gap`, `unavailable` or `not-applicable`. Gaps need reason and actionable findings. Unavailable is only for exact host pairs in the request; inspect the implementation that can be checked locally. Not-applicable is only for inactive conditional external/release gates and must name the condition and why it is inactive. No implicit waivers of repository behavior.

For the independent audit surface of the closure gate, use `result: verified`, `auditEvidence: true` and an assertion explaining the inventory/wiring review; the launcher/validator supplies its own execution proof instead of requiring a recursively pre-existing audit receipt. This exception applies only to a surface named `independent-audit` or `acceptance-audit` or `audit` on a gate, never to product tests.

PASS means all locally available obligations are proven, no local gap or finding remains. GAPS lists known missing behavior/evidence; BLOCKED explains why a reliable assessment is unavailable. Completion flags are computed by the host, not invented by the auditor. For delta review, inspect changed file hashes and consumers, close previous findings with new proof and return a complete current inventory. Request a fresh full audit if scope or independence no longer permits delta review.

+private fun visibleActions(
+    screen: ScreenId,
+    stableId: String?,
+    workspace: Workspace,
+    actions: List<ScreenActionDescriptor>,
+): List<ScreenActionDescriptor> {
+    if (screen != ScreenId.BATCH_DETAIL) return actions
+    val batch = stableId?.let { id -> workspace.batches.firstOrNull { it.id.value == id } } ?: return emptyList()
+    val visibleIds = batchDetailActionIds(batch)
+    return actions.filter { action -> action.id.value in visibleIds }
+}
+
+private fun batchDetailActionIds(batch: GrowBatch): Set<String> {
+    val configuredStates = batch.recipe.stages.map { stage ->
+        when (stage.stage) {
+            GrowStage.SOAKING -> BatchState.SOAKING
+            GrowStage.SOWN -> BatchState.SOWN
+            GrowStage.BLACKOUT_OR_WEIGHT -> BatchState.BLACKOUT_OR_WEIGHT
+            GrowStage.LIGHT_GROWTH -> BatchState.LIGHT_GROWTH
+            GrowStage.READY_FOR_HARVEST -> BatchState.READY_FOR_HARVEST
+        }
+    }
+    val stateIndex = configuredStates.indexOf(batch.state)
+    val hasNextStage = stateIndex >= 0 && stateIndex + 1 < configuredStates.size
+    val canSkipStage = stateIndex >= 0 && stateIndex + 2 < configuredStates.size
+    return buildSet {
+        add("add-observation")
+        add("delete-batch")
+        when (batch.state) {
+            BatchState.PLANNED -> {
+                add("confirm-sowing")
+                if (BatchState.SOAKING in configuredStates) add("start-soaking")
+            }
+            BatchState.SOAKING -> {
+                add("confirm-sowing")
+                add("schedule-soak-target")
+            }
+            BatchState.HARVESTED -> {
+                add("record-actual-mass")
+                add("repeat-batch")
+            }
+            BatchState.FAILED, BatchState.ABANDONED -> add("repeat-batch")
+            else -> Unit
+        }
+        if (!batch.state.isTerminal) add("close-batch")
+        if (!batch.state.isTerminal && batch.state != BatchState.SOAKING && hasNextStage) add("confirm-stage")
+        if (!batch.state.isTerminal && canSkipStage) add("skip-stage")
+        if (!batch.state.isTerminal && batch.events.isNotEmpty()) add("undo-stage")
+        if (batch.state.occupiesPlace && batch.placement is Placement.Unassigned) add("assign-overflow")
+    }
+}

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$localProperties = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath (Join-Path $repo "local.properties")
$sdkMatch = [regex]::Match($localProperties, '(?m)^sdk\.dir=(.+)$')
if (-not $sdkMatch.Success) { throw "local.properties does not define sdk.dir" }
$sdkRoot = $sdkMatch.Groups[1].Value.Trim().Replace('\:', ':').Replace('\\', '\')
$adb = Join-Path $sdkRoot "platform-tools/adb.exe"
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $adb)) { throw "ADB not found: $adb" }

$apk = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $repo $ApkPath)).Path
$reportDirectory = Join-Path $repo "build/reports/android-ui-smoke"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $reportDirectory | Out-Null

function Invoke-Adb {
    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments = $true)][string[]]$Arguments)
    $previousErrorActionPreference = $ErrorActionPreference
    $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
    $output = & $adb -s $AvdSerial @Arguments 2>&1
    $ErrorActionPreference = $previousErrorActionPreference
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "ADB failed: $($Arguments -join ' ')`n$($output -join "`n")"
    }
    return ($output -join "`n")
}

function Dump-Ui {
    param([string]$Name)
    $remote = "/sdcard/sproutpace-$Name.xml"
    Invoke-Adb shell uiautomator dump $remote | Out-Null
    $local = Join-Path $reportDirectory "$Name.xml"
    Invoke-Adb pull $remote $local | Out-Null
    return [xml](Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $local)
}

function Nodes {
    param([xml]$Document)
    return @($Document.SelectNodes("//node"))
}

function Find-Node {
    param(
        [xml]$Document,
        [string]$Text = "",
        [string]$ContentDescription = "",
        [string]$ClassName = "",
        [int]$Index = 0
    )
    $matches = @(Nodes $Document | Where-Object {
        ($Text -eq "" -or $_.GetAttribute("text") -eq $Text) -and
        ($ContentDescription -eq "" -or $_.GetAttribute("content-desc") -eq $ContentDescription) -and
        ($ClassName -eq "" -or $_.GetAttribute("class") -eq $ClassName)
    })
    $node = if ($Index -lt $matches.Count) { $matches[$Index] } else { $null }
    if ($null -eq $node) {
        $description = if ($Text) { "text '$Text'" } elseif ($ContentDescription) {
            "content description '$ContentDescription'"
        } else { "class '$ClassName' at index $Index" }
        throw "Missing UI node with $description"
    }
    return $node
}

function Find-ClickableAncestor {
    param([System.Xml.XmlNode]$Node)
    $candidate = $Node
    while ($null -ne $candidate -and $candidate.Name -eq "node") {
        if ($candidate.GetAttribute("clickable") -eq "true") { return $candidate }
        $candidate = $candidate.ParentNode
    }
    throw "Node has no clickable ancestor"
}

function Bounds {
    param([System.Xml.XmlNode]$Node)
    $match = [regex]::Match($Node.GetAttribute("bounds"), '^\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]$')
    if (-not $match.Success) { throw "Invalid node bounds: $($Node.GetAttribute('bounds'))" }
    return @(
        [int]$match.Groups[1].Value,
        [int]$match.Groups[2].Value,
        [int]$match.Groups[3].Value,
        [int]$match.Groups[4].Value
    )
}

function Tap-Node {
    param([System.Xml.XmlNode]$Node)
    $clickable = Find-ClickableAncestor $Node
    $bounds = Bounds $clickable
    Invoke-Adb shell input tap ([int](($bounds[0] + $bounds[2]) / 2)) ([int](($bounds[1] + $bounds[3]) / 2)) | Out-Null
}

function Assert-MinimumTarget {
    param(
        [System.Xml.XmlNode]$Node,
        [double]$MinimumPixels,
        [string]$Label
    )
    $clickable = Find-ClickableAncestor $Node
    $bounds = Bounds $clickable
    $width = $bounds[2] - $bounds[0]
    $height = $bounds[3] - $bounds[1]
    if ($width -lt $MinimumPixels -or $height -lt $MinimumPixels) {
        throw "$Label target is ${width}x${height}px; expected at least $([math]::Ceiling($MinimumPixels))px"
    }
}

function Assert-NodeOnScreen {
    param(
        [System.Xml.XmlNode]$Node,
        [int]$ScreenWidth,
        [int]$ScreenHeight,
        [string]$Label
    )
    $bounds = Bounds $Node
    if ($bounds[0] -lt 0 -or $bounds[1] -lt 0 -or $bounds[2] -gt $ScreenWidth -or
        $bounds[3] -gt $ScreenHeight -or $bounds[2] -le $bounds[0] -or $bounds[3] -le $bounds[1]) {
        throw "$Label is clipped or outside the screen: $($Node.GetAttribute('bounds'))"
    }
}

function Assert-KeyboardReachable {
    param(
        [string]$Text = "",
        [string]$ContentDescription = "",
        [string]$DumpPrefix,
        [int]$MaximumTabs = 24
    )
    for ($tabIndex = 1; $tabIndex -le $MaximumTabs; $tabIndex += 1) {
        Invoke-Adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_TAB | Out-Null
        $document = Dump-Ui "$DumpPrefix-$tabIndex"
        $focusedNodes = @(Nodes $document | Where-Object { $_.GetAttribute("focused") -eq "true" })
        foreach ($focused in $focusedNodes) {
            $scope = @($focused) + @($focused.SelectNodes(".//node"))
            $match = $scope | Where-Object {
                ($Text -eq "" -or $_.GetAttribute("text") -eq $Text) -and
                ($ContentDescription -eq "" -or $_.GetAttribute("content-desc") -eq $ContentDescription)
            } | Select-Object -First 1
            if ($null -ne $match) { return }
        }
    }
    $description = if ($Text) { "text '$Text'" } else { "content description '$ContentDescription'" }
    throw "Keyboard Tab could not reach $description"
}

function Find-NodeAfterForwardScroll {
    param(
        [string]$Text = "",
        [string]$ContentDescription = "",
        [string]$DumpPrefix,
        [int]$MaximumScrolls = 6
    )
    for ($scrollIndex = 0; $scrollIndex -le $MaximumScrolls; $scrollIndex += 1) {
        $document = Dump-Ui "$DumpPrefix-$scrollIndex"
        $match = Nodes $document | Where-Object {
            ($Text -eq "" -or $_.GetAttribute("text") -eq $Text) -and
            ($ContentDescription -eq "" -or $_.GetAttribute("content-desc") -eq $ContentDescription)
        } | Select-Object -First 1
        if ($null -ne $match) { return $match }
        if ($scrollIndex -lt $MaximumScrolls) {
            Invoke-Adb shell input swipe 500 1800 500 650 450 | Out-Null
            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 350
        }
    }
    $description = if ($Text) { "text '$Text'" } else { "content description '$ContentDescription'" }
    throw "Could not find $description after $MaximumScrolls forward scrolls"
}

function Start-App {
    Invoke-Adb shell am force-stop $PackageName | Out-Null
    for ($attempt = 1; $attempt -le 3; $attempt += 1) {
        Invoke-Adb -Arguments @("shell", "am", "start", "-W", "-n", "$PackageName/$ActivityName") | Out-Null
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 350
        $activities = Invoke-Adb shell dumpsys activity activities
        if ($activities -match "ResumedActivity.*$([regex]::Escape($PackageName))") { return }
    }
    throw "SproutPace did not become the resumed Android activity after three launch attempts"
}
